block.title: the girder patrol and the floor-strike eel
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, widescreen arcade side-scrolling composition, subtle CRT scanline glow. Inside the machine-gut of a riveted steel fortress: layered girders overhead, fat pipes sweating condensation, and a gallery of amber running lights that fades from dark rust-amber near the floor to bright furnace-amber overhead. In the middle distance a SENTINEL WALKER strides left along a girder catwalk — a squat twin-legged guard machine, heavy barrel torso bristling with rivets, two thick reverse-jointed legs with clawed feet clamped on the beam, a single red sensor eye sweeping a thin amber searchlight cone across the pipes, shoulder-mounted short cannons tracking. Below it, erupting out of an open maintenance trench in the deck plating, a TRENCH EEL — a long segmented steel serpent with ring-plate segments, a blunt snout lined with filing-tooth ridges, violet core-light leaking between its joints, its body thrown into a hard S-curve as it whips up toward the KESTREL. The KESTREL is banking between two pipe stacks in the foreground, steel-blue dart hull with a bold blue stripe, cyan canopy, orange engine glow flaring as it cuts thrust, blue bullets sparking harmlessly off the walker's riveted chest plate. Deep-navy shadow behind the girder layers, never pure black. No text, no UI elements.

block.notes: Color reference: amber light ramp #6a4418→#e8a030, eel joint-glow violet #b84cff, walker eye red #ff3a3a, steel body gunmetal with warm rust tinting. The warm-only lighting is what separates Citadel from every other metal zone — the negative explicitly bans blue-green key light. Flux.2 first: two creatures plus architecture plus ship is four-subject traffic.
